Aerie.name: Aerie
Aerie.description: Each installed Raven Black ICE destroys Programs instead of derezzing.

Airhypo Bayonet.name: Airhypo Bayonet
Airhypo Bayonet.description:
A hypodermic syringe that can deliver 1 dose of any liquid compound to the target.

Requires 1 Action to reload the Airhypo Bayonet.

Ask Alex Anything.name: Ask Alex Anything
Ask Alex Anything.description:
App: Allows users to search for information on the CitiNet.

Pre-Installed on all agents by default.

BabelChat.name: BabelChat
BabelChat.description:
App: Allows users to send and receive text and video messages.

Pre-Installed on all agents by default.

BangMe!.name: BangMe!
BangMe!.description: App: Online banking and peer to peer payment system.

Big SAAI.name: Big SAAI
Big SAAI.description: App: Grants a +1 bonus to your agent's Library Search functions.

Bottle Dynamo.name: Bottle Dynamo
Bottle Dynamo.description: A dynamo on your bike's wheel for converting mechanical energy into electricity. Charges a battery pack (such as for weapons) in one hour.

Brainwasher.name: Brainwasher
Brainwasher.description:
App: Provides basic therapy.

Use for 1 week before receiving therapy, then roll [[/r 1d10 #Brainwasher Therapy]]

  • On even results: Therapy is takes 1 less day to complete.

  • On odd results: Therapy is takes 1 more day to complete.

Bulletproof Glass.name: Bulletproof Glass
Bulletproof Glass.description:
Enclosure glass is now considered thin cover with 7 HP. Refer to the cover rules in CP:R, pg. 182.

Bike first requires the Enclosure upgrade to install this upgrade.

Bushido Accelerator.name: Bushido Accelerator
Bushido Accelerator.description: +3 Speed to all installed Killer Black ICE.

Buzzsaw Arm.name: Buzzsaw Arm
Buzzsaw Arm.description:
Construction Time: 1 days
Salvage DV: 9
Construction Modifier: +1

Acts as a Very Heavy Melee Weapon, chooose location: Front, Rear, Side

A passenger must use their Action to extend or retract the arm.

Catapult.name: Catapult
Catapult.description:
Construction Time: 1 days
Salvage DV: 13
Construction Modifier: +1

A Heavy Weapon mounted on the roof that can launch any object the size of a person.

Any individual launched by the catapult must make a DV 15 Athletics Check to land safely on the ground or the person takes 2d6 damage directly to their HP.

Cockpit Glass.name: Cockpit Glass
Cockpit Glass.description:
Construction Time: 3 days
Salvage DV: 15
Construction Modifier: +1

Protects the driver and occupants with Thick Bulletproof Glass 30(HP).

Cold-Weather Jacket Lining.name: Cold-Weather Jacket Lining
Cold-Weather Jacket Lining.description: Upgrade for any Jacket fashion item. User will not suffer Exposure penalties from cold temperatures (CP:R pg 181).

Combat Recorder.name: Combat Recorder
Combat Recorder.description:
Real-world Combat data is invaluable for Black ICE development.

If another Netrunner in the same NET Architecture fails a Death Save, the last 5 minutes of non-self incriminating Netrun combat data is saved to the Cyberdeck. Recordings can be sold for 50eb.

Combat Spikes.name: Combat Spikes
Combat Spikes.description:
Construction Time: 3 days
Salvage DV: 13
Construction Modifier: +1

Increases ramming damage by 2d6 when boosted by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.dlc_upgrades.Item.n51IrwLux1v0fY78]{NOS}.

Constructing this upgrade a second time increases the damage from 2d6 > 3d6

Crunch Whistle.name: Crunch Whistle
Crunch Whistle.description:
Connects your cyberdeck to a breacher.

When this upgrade is installed, a Netrunner may add their Interface Rank to the result when hacking an agent. (Active Effect requires manual configuration)

Cuddlefish Outfit (Costly).name: Cuddlefish Outfit (Costly)
Cuddlefish Outfit (Costly).description: A cute outfit for your Captain Cuddlefish Ultra Snag-Em! Prized by collectors.

Cuddlefish Outfit (Default).name: Cuddlefish Outfit (Default)
Cuddlefish Outfit (Default).description: A cute outfit for your Captain Cuddlefish Ultra Snag-Em! Collect them all!

Cycle Armor.name: Cycle Armor
Cycle Armor.description:
Bicycle Armored with 7 SP.

Bike first requires the Reinforced Frame upgrade to install this upgrade.

Defense Sequencer.name: Defense Sequencer
Defense Sequencer.description: If an active Armor Program is derezzed or destroyed, Defense Sequencer activates a yet-unused copy of Armor Program at the start of the Netrunner's turn.

Electric Pedal Assist.name: Electric Pedal Assist
Electric Pedal Assist.description:
Electric motorised system helping to pedal, increasing speed, lowering tiredness.

Increases the bicycle's Speed (narrative) to the next BODY tier or adds 5MPH/8KPH to Speed (narrative) if already at the highest BODY tier.

Rider get +4 bonus to Endurance Checks to resisting exhaustion when riding.

Elflines Online.name: Elflines Online
Elflines Online.description: A new in-box copy Elflines Online. Requires the Segotari RUSH Revolution to play.

Elflines Online Elftracker.name: Elflines Online Elftracker
Elflines Online Elftracker.description: App: A companion app for ELO that allows users to track and in-game stats and connect with other players.

Enclosure.name: Enclosure
Enclosure.description:
The bike becomes a trike with a covering body of fiberglass and plastic.

Can't install this Upgrade with the Folding Frame upgrade.

Extended Seat.name: Extended Seat
Extended Seat.description: An elongated saddle, gaining a seat for a passenger.

Extra AV-4 Engine.name: Extra AV-4 Engine
Extra AV-4 Engine.description:
Construction Time: 2 days
Salvage DV: 15
Construction Modifier: +2

An Extra AV-4 Engine can be added for each Extra Chassis installed into your Punknaught Core.

Extra Chassis.name: Extra Chassis
Extra Chassis.description:
Construction Time: 3 days
Salvage DV: 13
Construction Modifier: +2

Only 3 Extra Chassis can be installed onto a Punknaught Core.

Each Extra Chassis increases ramming damage by 1d6.

Feline Instinct.name: Feline Instinct
Feline Instinct.description: If an installed Sabertooth Black ICE destroys a program, that Sabertooth deals an extra 1d6 of damage on each subsequent attack for the duration of the Netrun.

Folding Frame.name: Folding Frame
Folding Frame.description:
You can now fold your bike to the size of a large suitcase for easier transport and storage.

Can't install this Upgrade with Enclosure, Reinforced Frame, or Smuggling Compartment upgrades.

Grapple Gun Underbarrel.name: Grapple Gun Underbarrel
Grapple Gun Underbarrel.description: Mounts under any crossbow or shoulder arm. Functions like a standard @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.VrwVUEHuMCGjp8Fi].

Gun Mount.name: Gun Mount
Gun Mount.description:
A system to attach an Assault Rifle, a Heavy SMG or a Shotgun on the handlebars, along with a firing button.

Shoots only forwards.

Mounting and detaching requires one Action.

Handprint Scanner.name: Handprint Scanner
Handprint Scanner.description:
App Use your agent to scan a handprint by making a DV13 Criminology Check.

Scanning a full handprint takes 3 rounds. 5 partial prints may be combined to create a full handprint.

Hangry Hangry Dragon.name: Hangry Hangry Dragon
Hangry Hangry Dragon.description: Everytime an installed Dragon Black ICE destroys a Program it regains full REZ.

Hot-Weather Jacket Lining.name: Hot-Weather Jacket Lining
Hot-Weather Jacket Lining.description:
Upgrade for any Jacket fashion item. User will not suffer Exposure penalties from hot temperatures (CP:R pg 181).

Heatwaves double all penalties from heavier armor (NCW pg 5). For example, a user with Medium Armorjack takes a -4 penalty to MOVE, DEX, and REF during a Heatwave. Hot-Weather Jacket Lining decreases each of these penalties by 1.

HusTool.name: HusTool
HusTool.description:
App: Find odd jobs and get paid! Jobs take 30 minutes to complete and pay 10eb.

Available jobs are determined by the GM, roll [[/r 1d10 #HusTool]]

  • On a 1: Factors outside of your control prevent you from finishing the errand.

    • You waste your time and don't get paid.

  • On a 10: The errand is completed, but you encounter trouble.

    • GM rolls on an appropriate encounter table.

Neon Lightning.name: Neon Lightning
Neon Lightning.description:
Fiber-optic lights on bike's frame and wheels.

Considered as a Light Tattoo when on or near the bike (gaining +2 Wardrobe & Style bonus)

NOS.name: NOS
NOS.description:
Construction Time: 1 days
Salvage DV: 13
Construction Modifier: +2

Boost the Punknaught's speed and gain an extra Move Action for one turn.

May be installed multiple times. Each tank only provides one turn of boost.

Perfume Shoppe.name: Perfume Shoppe
Perfume Shoppe.description: Skunk Black ICE will only take 1 option slot to install.

Punknaught Armor.name: Punknaught Armor
Punknaught Armor.description:
Construction Time: 1 days
Salvage DV: 13
Construction Modifier: +1

Provides SP13 armor to your Punknaught. Preem attacks made against your Punknaught ignore this armor unless this upgrade has been installed twice.

Reinforced Frame.name: Reinforced Frame
Reinforced Frame.description:
Bike is now more resistant: +5 SDP and rider can be BODY 11 or more.

Can't install this Upgrade with Folding Frame Upgrade.

Retina Scanner.name: Retina Scanner
Retina Scanner.description:
App Use your agent to scan an eye, requires a camera or MicroVideo upgrade.

Copying a retinal patern takes 5 rounds and may require a number of DV13 Brawling Checks to restrain an unwilling subject.

Roach Race.name: Roach Race
Roach Race.description: App: A retro sidescroller game from Poland.

Security System.name: Security System
Security System.description:
Linked with your Agent to electrify your bike. A thief must resist DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs or unhand the bike.

Bike is registered with a Nano-VIN.

Segotari Agent Game.name: Segotari Agent Game
Segotari Agent Game.description: A game that uses the Self-Adaptive AI onboard your Agent to generate new levels or respond in real time to player input.

Segotari RUSH Game (Used).name: Segotari RUSH Game (Used)
Segotari RUSH Game (Used).description: A used virtual reality game formatted for the original RUSH virtual reality headset.

Segotari RUSH Revolution Game.name: Segotari RUSH Revolution Game
Segotari RUSH Revolution Game.description: A virtual reality game formatted for the RUSH Revolution headset.

Silencer.name: Silencer
Silencer.description:
Greatly reduces the weapon's audio profile.

A Perception Check to determine the location of the gunshot may be rolled against a DV set by the GM.

Smithy.name: Smithy
Smithy.description:
Be prepared for anything. Enter a NET Architecture full of Black ICE and you don't have have a Sword Program handy? Swap out your useless Banhammer with the press of a button.

Use Meat Action to change any and all installed Sword Programs into Banhammer Programs or vice versa.

Smuggling Compartment.name: Smuggling Compartment
Smuggling Compartment.description:
Adds a small hidden storage space in the frame.

1 inch x 6 inches (2.54cm x 15.24cm)

DV17 Conceal/Reveal Object check to discover.

Can't install this Upgrade with Folding Frame.

Snaketrap.name: Snaketrap
Snaketrap.description: Protects against the first attack (Asp, Raven, or Poison Flatline effects) that would destroy a random installed Program. This protective effect can be use only once per Netrun even if multiple copies of Snaketrap are installed.

Spike Strip Launcher.name: Spike Strip Launcher
Spike Strip Launcher.description:
Construction Time: 1 days
Salvage DV: 9
Construction Modifier: +1

This Heavy Weapon launches a coil of metal spikes from the rear of your Punknaught.

Drivers following behind you must make a DV17 Drive Land Vehicle check to avoid 4d6 weak point damage.

Stunt Frame.name: Stunt Frame
Stunt Frame.description:
The bike loses weight and gains maneuverability.

Rider obtain a +2 bonus to Athletics skill checks when riding and doing maneuvers.

Swamp Mist.name: Swamp Mist
Swamp Mist.description:
Wisp Black ICE deal 2d6 damage instead of 1d6.

Black ICE Program restrictions: Only Wisps can be installed.

Swifty Clean.name: Swifty Clean
Swifty Clean.description: Netrunner can roll Cloak twice in a single NET Action and take the higher roll. Cloak can only be used once per Netrun when Swifty Clean is installed.

The Garden.name: The Garden
The Garden.description: App: A free social media platform hosted by Ziggurat. Users require an account to comment or publish content.

Trailer.name: Trailer
Trailer.description:
Hook with a small cargo trailer.

5 feet x 1.5 feet (1.5m x 0.46m).

An action is needed to attach and detach the trailer.

Turret.name: Turret
Turret.description:
Construction Time: 1 days
Salvage DV: 13
Construction Modifier: +1

Adds a swivel mount that can support any 2-handed ranged weapon you already own. This upgrade may be constructed 3 times for each chassis installed into your Punknaught.

A passenger riding the Punknaught may use their Action to fire or reload the weapon.

WatchBox.name: WatchBox
WatchBox.description:
App: Turns your agent into an alarm system.

Requires 5 minutes to scan and establish a security perimeter. The alarm is triggered by loud noises, bright lights, and movement.

DV13 Stealth Check to avoid detection.

Waterproof Jacket Lining.name: Waterproof Jacket Lining
Waterproof Jacket Lining.description:
Upgrade for any Jacket fashion item. Mechanically similar to an umbrella, does not serve as a wetsuit.

Protects against Acid Rain. For every minute exposed to Acid Rain, all armor ablates by 1 SP (NCW pg 4).

+2 to Resist Torture/Drugs Checks from Blood Rain exposure. Severe Blood Rain applies the effects of a Vial of Biotoxin on failed check (NCW pg 4).

ZPost.name: ZPost
ZPost.description:
App: Allows users to organize, send, and receive emails.

Pre-Installed on all agents by default.
